question: Which supreme court judge has surved in international court of justice?
text:
Your question doesn't say which country's Supreme Court you mean. I'm assuming India, since that is the usual context for it.

**Dalveer Bhandari** is the best-known example.
- He served as a senior judge of the Supreme Court of India and was elevated to it on 28 October 2005.[1]
- He has been a Member of the ICJ since 27 April 2012, and was re-elected from 6 February 2018 for a nine-year term.[1] That term runs to early 2027.
- He was on the ICJ bench that gave the verdict in the Kulbhushan Jadhav case.[2]

**Raghunandan Swarup Pathak** is another example. He was Chief Justice of India and sat on the ICJ from 1989 to 1991.[3]

Other countries have also sent Supreme Court judges to the ICJ. One example I remember from general knowledge is Christopher Weeramantry of Sri Lanka, who was a Supreme Court judge there and later ICJ Vice-President. I didn't verify that in this search.

If you meant another country, such as the US or Pakistan, tell me and I'll look into it.
